convos:
## lately-d27 after Josefine's death — lately with Courtney (d27)
> YOU PICK [agency:ask_expedition] 
YOU: "What did you see out there?"
NPC: "Saw things with too many joints. Give them room. That's the whole lesson."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "I'd love to. Lead the way." (They're already checking your pack.)

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "You don't have to say it all at once."
NPC: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sure — what's on your mind?"

> YOU PICK [ask:lately] 
YOU: "What's weighing on you right now?"
NPC: "Good question." "I dreamed Josefine was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
## lately-d33 after Courtney's death — lately with Willie (d33)
> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "Rest and clean water aren't cutting it. If this turns, I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. I need someone who knows what they're doing."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I’ll come back to help."
NPC: "You don't know what that means to me. Thank you."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: As I said — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Courtney is gone and Victor is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."

> YOU PICK [teach] 
NPC: You show them White Oak Acorns — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."
## lately-d33 after Victor's death — lately with Willie (d33)
> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: As I said — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Forget I said anything. What did you want?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Courtney is gone and Victor is gone. The fire doesn't care. That's what gets me — the fire doesn't care."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "Come see what I found. You won't believe it."

> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "All right. Let's go."
NPC: Willie shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "Okay. We'll pick this up later."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)
## lately-d38 after Ananya's death — lately with Aurora (d38)
> YOU PICK [ask:goal] 
YOU: "Tell me what you actually want. Not the polite version."
NPC: "Good question." My notes are a mess. Future scholars will hate me. They'll still read them.

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm here. Go on."
NPC: They relax, a fraction. This is going well.

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "If we don't write it down, it didn't happen. I'm writing it all down."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm here. Go on."
NPC: "Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "My notes are a mess. Future scholars will hate me. They'll still read them."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "A hundred years from now someone should know we were here and what it cost."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "Every name, every day, every meal. The boring stuff is the important stuff."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "I record the arguments too. Especially the arguments. That's the real history."
## lately-d38 after Willie's death — lately with Aurora (d38)
> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "You alright?"
NPC: "Most days I don't think about it. Today I am. Appreciate you noticing."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind? What's the worst that happens."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "We lost Ananya and Willie. I do the headcount without thinking. Then I think."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Yeah? What's up, as it were?"

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:trade] 
YOU: "We never finished — trading knowledge."
NPC: "About trading knowledge — yeah, we never did get back to that."

> YOU PICK [ask:goal] 
YOU: "Tell me what you actually want. Not the polite version."
NPC: "Good question." I record the arguments too. Especially the arguments. That's the real history.
## lately-d67 after Aurora's death — lately with Shaaban (d67)
> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Hey — are you alright?"
NPC: "Real talk — You're kind. Don't let this place change that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:stay] 
YOU: "I'm not going anywhere."
NPC: They shift over, making room. "Stay as long as you like."

> YOU PICK [dlg:empathize] 
YOU: "I'm here."
NPC: "I keep going over it. Having someone here... it slows the spiral."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Take your time."
NPC: "Help me haul something back? Too much for one."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Right, so — Still on that hard time."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Take your time."
NPC: Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Like I said — Still on that hard time."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Take your time."
NPC: "We're done for now. Not done-done. For now."
## lately-d73 after Wei's death — lately with Shaaban (d73)
> YOU PICK [dlg:help] 
YOU: "How can I help?"
NPC: "My stomach's been empty so long I've stopped feeling it, and that's worse. I need food before I can't work at all."

> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "I just told you — what else is on your mind?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: As I said — They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "We've covered this one. Ask me something else."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Take your time."
NPC: "That's enough for now. It'll percolate."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)
## lately-d75 after Sofia's death — lately with Shaaban (d75)
> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I got lost in it for a second. What did you want to ask?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "I dreamed Sofia was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "Sleep's gone strange. I count portions out loud before eating at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "...Fine. This had better be worth it."

> YOU PICK [teach] 
NPC: You show them White Oak Acorns — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
NPC: "Go. But sit with what I said."
